source_title: A Diamond is Forever Ranks the Luckiest Jewelry in Tennis
source_excerpt:
NEW YORK , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- From necklaces worn through Grand Slam victories to earrings and bracelets associated with defining moments, jewelry has become a recognizable part of some of tennis's greatest champions' on-court identities. But which pieces have become most closely associated with winning?
Inspired by the story behind the iconic tennis bracelet, a new study by A Diamond Is Forever analyzed 10 tennis players and their signature jewelry pieces to reveal the luckiest jewelry in tennis.
The A Diamond Is Forever study revealed that Serena Williams's signature heart necklaces rank as the luckiest jewelry in tennis, with an overall score of 90 out of 100 .
Williams scored 9/10 for Major Championship Titles , with 23 Grand Slam singles titles.
Her heart necklaces scored 9/10 for the Championship Jewelry Association , appearing during 11 Grand Slam championship wins analyzed in the study.
She scored 9/10 for Championship Jewelry Search Surge , following a 100% Google Trends search surge.
Williams's heart necklaces generated approximately 88,700 social and media mentions , earning a Cultural Reach score of 9/10.
Novak Djokovic ranks second , with his signature cross necklace earning an overall score of 75 out of 100 .
Djokovic earned 10/10 for Major Championship Titles , with 24 Grand Slam singles championships â the highest number among the players analyzed.
His cross necklace scored 9/10 for the Championship Jewelry Association , appearing during 11 Grand Slam wins analyzed.
The piece recorded a 40% Google Trends search surge , earning a Championship Jewelry Search Surge score of 1/10 relative to the other players in the dataset.
Djokovic and his cross necklace generated approximately 123,700 social and media mentions , earning the highest Cultural Reach score in the study at 10/10.
3. Aryna Sabalenka â Material Good Jewelry
Aryna Sabalenka ranks third , with her custom Material Good jewelry earning an overall score of 73 out of 100 .
Sabalenka scored 6/10 for Major Championship Titles , with four Grand Slam singles championships.
Her Material Good jewelry scored 7/10 for Championship Jewelry Association , with one confirmed Grand Slam-winning association.
The jewelry recorded a 100% Google Trends search surge , earning a Championship Jewelry Search Surge score of 9/10.
Her signature jewelry generated approximately 2,200 social and media mentions , earning a Cultural Reach score of 7/10.
